name: matvecE_single
doc: 单位向量作用：A·eⱼ = A 的第 j 列（eⱼ = `EuclideanSpace.single j 1`）。
stmt:
lemma matvecE_single (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    matvecE A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) = fun i : Fin m => A i j
proof:
by
  ext i
  unfold matvecE
  calc
    (∑ j_1 : Fin n, A i j_1 * EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) j_1) = A i j * 1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · simp
      · intro b hb hbj
        rw [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, if_neg hbj]
        simp
      · intro hj
        simp at hj
    _ = A i j := by ring

name: matvecE_adjoint_eq
doc: 内积对偶：⟪Ax, y⟫ = ⟪x, Aᵀy⟫（转置是伴随；求和交换）。
stmt:
lemma matvecE_adjoint_eq (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    (inner (matvecE A x) y : ℝ) = (inner x (matvecE Aᵀ y) : ℝ)
proof:
by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
  simp [Matrix.dotProduct, matvecE, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  calc
    (∑ i : Fin m, (∑ j : Fin n, A i j * x j) * y i)
        = ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin n, (A i j * x j) * y i := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin n, ∑ i : Fin m, (A i j * x j) * y i := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin n, x j * (∑ i : Fin m, A i j * y i) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          calc
            (∑ i : Fin m, (A i j * x j) * y i) = ∑ i : Fin m, x j * (A i j * y i) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro i hi
              ring
            _ = x j * (∑ i : Fin m, A i j * y i) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]

theorem droppedCount_eq_zero_iff (load capacity : iota → Nat) :
    droppedCount load capacity = 0 ↔ Balanced load capacity
proof:
by
  unfold droppedCount Balanced
  constructor
  · intro h e
    have h0 : droppedAt load capacity e = 0 := by
      have hz : ∀ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset iota), droppedAt load capacity x = 0 :=
        Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp h
      exact hz e (Finset.mem_univ e)
    exact (droppedAt_eq_zero_iff load capacity e).mp h0
  · intro h
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => ?_
    exact (droppedAt_eq_zero_iff load capacity e).mpr (h e)

name: unit_normalize_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem unit_normalize_lipschitz {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (x y : E) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hy : c ≤ ‖y‖) :
    ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ ≤ (2 / c) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  have hx0 : ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    linarith
  have hy0 : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    linarith
  have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
                                    
  have hnorm : |‖y‖ - ‖x‖| ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
    simpa [abs_sub_comm] using abs_norm_sub_norm_le x y
                                   
  have hrecip : |1 / ‖x‖ - 1 / ‖y‖| ≤ ‖x - y‖ / (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) := by
    have hcalc : 1 / ‖x‖ - 1 / ‖y‖ = (‖y‖ - ‖x‖) / (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) := by
      field_simp [hx0, hy0]
    rw [hcalc]
    have hdenpos : 0 < ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ := mul_pos hxpos (by linarith)
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hdenpos)]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnorm (le_of_lt hdenpos)
  calc
    ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖
        = ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖x‖) • y + ((1 / ‖x‖) • y - (1 / ‖y‖) • y)‖ := by
          congr 1
          abel
    _ ≤ ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖x‖) • y‖ + ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • y - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • (x - y)‖ + ‖((1 / ‖x‖) - (1 / ‖y‖)) • y‖ := by
          rw [smul_sub]
          rw [sub_smul]
    _ = (1 / ‖x‖) * ‖x - y‖ + |1 / ‖x‖ - 1 / ‖y‖| * ‖y‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul]
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (by exact one_div_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hxpos))]
    _ ≤ (1 / ‖x‖) * ‖x - y‖ + (‖x - y‖ / (‖x‖ * ‖y‖)) * ‖y‖ := by
          exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrecip (norm_nonneg _)) _
    _ = (2 / ‖x‖) * ‖x - y‖ := by
          field_simp [hy0]
          ring
    _ ≤

name: center_norm_le
stmt:
theorem center_norm_le {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ‖z - ((∑ i : Fin n, z i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))‖ ≤ ‖z‖
proof:
by
  let c : ℝ := (∑ i : Fin n, z i) / n
  let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := z - c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
                                    
  have horth : inner w (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = (0 : ℝ) := by
    unfold w
    have hz : inner z (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = ∑ i : Fin n, z i := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
      simp [Matrix.dotProduct, constOne]
    have h1n : inner (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = (n : ℝ) := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
      simp [Matrix.dotProduct, constOne]
    have hc1 : inner (c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = c * n := by
      rw [inner_smul_left]
      rw [h1n]
      simp
    have hc : c * n = ∑ i : Fin n, z i := by
      unfold c
      by_cases hn : (n : ℝ) = 0
      · have hn0 : n = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
        subst n
        simp
      · field_simp [hn]
    calc
      inner (z - c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
          = inner z (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) - inner (c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by rw [inner_sub_left]
      _ = (∑ i : Fin n, z i) - c * n := by
            rw [hz, hc1]
      _ = 0 := by
            rw [hc]
            ring
                
  have hzdec : z = w + c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    unfold

name: center_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem center_lipschitz {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ‖(x - ((∑ i : Fin n, x i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
      - (y - ((∑ i : Fin n, y i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))‖
      ≤ ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
                                                   
  have hlin : (x - ((∑ i : Fin n, x i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
        - (y - ((∑ i : Fin n, y i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
      = (x - y) - ((∑ i : Fin n, (x - y) i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    ext j
    have hmean : (∑ i : Fin n, x i) / n - (∑ i : Fin n, y i) / n
        = (∑ i : Fin n, (x - y) i) / n := by

        simpa [Pi.sub_apply] using (Finset.sum_sub_distrib : (∑ i : Fin n, x i) - (∑ i : Fin n, y i) = ∑ i : Fin n, x i - y i)
      rw [hsum, sub_div]
    simp [hmean]
    ring

name: unit_normalize_two_div_not_attained
doc:
(2/c) 界在取等点对上是**严格**的：在 ℝ 上取 x = c、y = −c，则
    比值 2/‖x−y‖ = 1/c < 2/c，即 2 < (2/c)·(2c) = 4
    ⟹ RealNormLipschitz 的 2/c 界不是紧界。
    **边界**：本式仅在 ℝ 这一具体空间上证明 2/c 不取等；1/c 的普遍上界
    另由本节 `unit_normalize_lipschitz_sharp` 与 `unit_normalize_constant_lower_bound`
    给出（本文件对一般赋范空间只证下界，不主张 1/c 成立）。
stmt:
theorem unit_normalize_two_div_not_attained (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ‖(1 / ‖(c : ℝ)‖) • (c : ℝ) - (1 / ‖(-c : ℝ)‖) • (-c : ℝ)‖
      < (2 / c) * ‖(c : ℝ) - (-c : ℝ)‖
proof:
by
  have heq2 : ‖(c : ℝ) - (-c : ℝ)‖ = 2 * c := by
    rw [show (c : ℝ) - (-c) = 2 * c by ring, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
  rw [unit_normalize_antipodal_real c hc, heq2]
  have hval2 : (2 / c) * (2 * c) = 4 := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hc]; ring
  rw [hval2]
  norm_num

name: safe_normalize_lipschitz_on
doc:
**球内 Lipschitz 界**：`‖x‖ ≤ R`、`‖y‖ ≤ R`、`0 ≤ R`、`0 < ε` ⟹
`‖safeNormalize ε x − safeNormalize ε y‖ ≤ ((R + ε)/ε²)·‖x − y‖`。
stmt:
theorem safe_normalize_lipschitz_on (ε R : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (_hR : 0 ≤ R) (x y : E)
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ R) (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖safeNormalize ε x - safeNormalize ε y‖ ≤ ((R + ε) / ε ^ 2) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  have ha : 0 < ‖x‖ + ε := safe_normalize_denom_pos ε x hε
  have hterm1 : ‖(‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ • (x - y)‖ ≤ ε⁻¹ * ‖x - y‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ha)]
    have hle : (‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ ≤ ε⁻¹ := (inv_le_inv₀ ha hε).mpr (safe_normalize_denom_ge ε x)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (norm_nonneg _)
  have hterm2 : ‖((‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ - (‖y‖ + ε)⁻¹) • y‖ ≤ (‖x - y‖ / ε ^ 2) * R := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul (safe_normalize_radial_bound ε x y hε) hy (norm_nonneg y)
      (div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (pow_pos hε 2).le)
  calc ‖safeNormalize ε x - safeNormalize ε y‖
      = ‖(‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ • (x - y) + ((‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ - (‖y‖ + ε)⁻¹) • y‖ := by
          rw [safe_normalize_sub_decomp]
    _ ≤ ‖(‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ • (x - y)‖ + ‖((‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ - (‖y‖ + ε)⁻¹) • y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ε⁻¹ * ‖x - y‖ + (‖x - y‖ / ε ^ 2) * R := add_le_add hterm1 hterm2
    _ = ((R + ε) / ε ^ 2) * ‖x - y‖ := by
          field_simp
          ring

lemma rms_scale (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) :
    rms (fun i => α * x i) = α * rms x
proof:
by
                      
  have hsum : ∑ i, (α * x i) ^ 2 = α ^ 2 * ∑ i, x i ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    ring
  unfold rms
  calc
    Real.sqrt ((∑ i, (α * x i) ^ 2) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ))
        = Real.sqrt ((α ^ 2 * ∑ i, x i ^ 2) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) := by rw [hsum]
    _ = α * Real.sqrt ((∑ i, x i ^ 2) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) := by
                                                
      have hc : 0 ≤ (∑ i, x i ^ 2) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by
        exact div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => sq_nonneg _)) (by positivity)
      have hαsq : 0 ≤ α ^ 2 := sq_nonneg α
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (α ^ 2) = α := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs α]
        exact abs_of_nonneg hα
      rw [mul_div_assoc]
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul hαsq ((∑ i, x i ^ 2) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ))]
      rw [hsqrt]

name: rmsNormE_constant_iff
doc:
**`rmsNormE_constant_iff`（紧常数刻画）**：n > 0 时，
    K 是 RMSNorm 在 {‖·‖ ≥ c} 上的有效 Lipschitz 常数**当且仅当** √n/c ≤ K。
    结合 `rmsNormE_sqrt_lipschitz`（充分）与对径取等点（必要），真正常数 = √n/c。
stmt:
theorem rmsNormE_constant_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (c K : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), c ≤ ‖x‖ → c ≤ ‖y‖ →
        ‖rmsNormE x - rmsNormE y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖) ↔ Real.sqrt n / c ≤ K
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hK
    rcases exists_norm_eq hn c hc with ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hy : c ≤ ‖-x‖ := by rw [norm_neg, hx]
    have h1 : ‖rmsNormE x - rmsNormE (-x)‖ ≤ K * ‖x - (-x)‖ :=
      hK x (-x) (le_of_eq hx.symm) hy
    have h2 : (Real.sqrt n / c) * ‖x - (-x)‖ ≤ K * ‖x - (-x)‖ := by
      rwa [rmsNormE_sharp_attained x c hc hx] at h1
    have hd : 0 < ‖x - (-x)‖ := by
      rw [norm_sub_neg x c hx]
      linarith
    rcases (mul_le_mul_right hd).mp h2 with hle
    exact hle
  · intro hK x y hx hy
    calc
      ‖rmsNormE x - rmsNormE y‖ ≤ (Real.sqrt n / c) * ‖x - y‖ :=
        rmsNormE_sqrt_lipschitz x y c hc hx hy
      _ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK (norm_nonneg _)

theorem selProd_eq_from (A : ℕ → 𝔸) (k t : ℕ) :

  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ((List.range n).map (fun i => A (k + n - 1 - i))).prod

    intro n

    | zero => simp [selProdFrom]
    | succ m ih =>

name: selProd_concat
doc:

`selProd A k t = selProd A m t * selProd A k m`。

「先走 `k→m`，再走 `m→t`」与「一次走 `k→t`」一致；**左侧因子是后一段**
（`selProd A m t = A_{t-1} ⋯ A_m`，`selProd A k m = A_{m-1} ⋯ A_k`），

by
  have hlen : t - k = (t - m) + (m - k) := by omega
  have hmap : (List.range (t - k)).map (fun i => A (t - 1 - i))
      = ((List.range (t - m)).map (fun i => A (t - 1 - i)))
        ++ ((List.range (m - k)).map (fun i => A (m - 1 - i))) := by
    rw [hlen, List.range_add, List.map_append]
    congr 1
    rw [List.map_map]
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro i hi
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]

    omega

doc:
**稳定界（收缩 ρ < 1，核心）**：`∀i, ‖A i‖ ≤ ρ < 1`、`∀k, ‖B k‖ ≤ M` ⟹
`‖h_t‖ ≤ M / (1 - ρ)` —— **一致有界**，与时间步 `t` 无关。

即选择性 SSM 的稳定性只要「时变乘子范数一致 < 1」即可，不依赖 `t`。
这正是 Mamba 用 `exp(Δ A)` 且 `A < 0` 强制 `‖A_t‖ < 1` 的原因。
证明：`∑_{k<t} ρ^{t-1-k} ≤ ∑_j ρ^j ≤ ∑'_j ρ^j = 1/(1-ρ)`。

theorem selState_norm_bound_contracting (A B : ℕ → 𝔸) (ρ M : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (hA : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ ≤ ρ) (hB : ∀ k, ‖B k‖ ≤ M) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖selState A B t‖ ≤ M / (1 - ρ)
proof:
by
  have hrev : ∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k) = ∑ j in range t, ρ ^ j :=
    sum_range_reflect (fun j => ρ ^ j) t
  have hsumm : Summable (fun j : ℕ => ρ ^ j) := summable_geometric_of_lt_one hρ0 hρ1
  have htsum : ∑' j : ℕ, ρ ^ j = (1 - ρ)⁻¹ := tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hρ0 hρ1
  have hfin : ∑ j in range t, ρ ^ j ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, ρ ^ j :=
    sum_le_tsum (range t) (fun j _ => pow_nonneg hρ0 j) hsumm
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - ρ := by linarith
  calc ‖selState A B t‖ ≤ M * ∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k) :=
        selState_norm_le_sum A B ρ M hρ0 hA hB t
    _ = M * ∑ j in range t, ρ ^ j := by rw [hrev]
    _ ≤ M * (1 - ρ)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← htsum]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfin hM
    _ = M / (1 - ρ) := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]

  have hrev : |dist i j - dist i k| ≤ dist j k := by
    simpa [dist_comm] using (abs_dist_sub_le (x := j) (y := k) (z := i))
  have hcalc : |(-m) * dist i j - (-m) * dist i k| = m * |dist i j - dist i k| := by
    rw [← mul_sub]
    simp [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg, hm]
  calc
    |(-m) * dist i j - (-m) * dist i k| = m * |dist i j - dist i k| := hcalc
    _ ≤ m * dist j k := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrev hm

name: abs_sin_sub_sin_le
doc:
sin 的 1-Lipschitz 界：`|sin x − sin y| ≤ |x − y|`
（和差化积 + `|sin t| ≤ |t|` + `|cos t| ≤ 1`）。
stmt: lemma abs_sin_sub_sin_le (x y : ℝ) : |Real.sin x - Real.sin y| ≤ |x - y|
proof:
by
  rw [Real.sin_sub_sin]
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by norm_num
  have hsin : |Real.sin ((x - y) / 2)| ≤ |(x - y) / 2| := Real.abs_sin_le_abs
  have hcos : |Real.cos ((x + y) / 2)| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_cos_le_one _
  calc
    |2 * Real.sin ((x - y) / 2) * Real.cos ((x + y) / 2)|
        = 2 * |Real.sin ((x - y) / 2)| * |Real.cos ((x + y) / 2)| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h2]
    _ ≤ 2 * |(x - y) / 2| * 1 := by
          have hc0 : 0 ≤ |Real.cos ((x + y) / 2)| := abs_nonneg _
          have hb : 0 ≤ 2 * |(x - y) / 2| := by positivity
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsin h2) hcos hc0 hb
    _ = |x - y| := by
          rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg h2]
          ring

name: abs_cos_sub_cos_le
doc: cos 的 1-Lipschitz 界：`|cos x − cos y| ≤ |x − y|`。
stmt: lemma abs_cos_sub_cos_le (x y : ℝ) : |Real.cos x - Real.cos y| ≤ |x - y|
proof:
by
  rw [Real.cos_sub_cos]
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by norm_num
  have h2abs : |(-2 : ℝ)| = 2 := by norm_num
  have hsin1 : |Real.sin ((x + y) / 2)| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_sin_le_one _
  have hsin2 : |Real.sin ((x - y) / 2)| ≤ |(x - y) / 2| := Real.abs_sin_le_abs
  calc
    |(-2) * Real.sin ((x + y) / 2) * Real.sin ((x - y) / 2)|
        = 2 * |Real.sin ((x + y) / 2)| * |Real.sin ((x - y) / 2)| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, h2abs]
    _ ≤ 2 * 1 * |(x - y) / 2| := by
          have hc0 : 0 ≤ |Real.sin ((x - y) / 2)| := abs_nonneg _
          have hb : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * 1 := by norm_num
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsin1 h2) hsin2 hc0 hb
    _ = |x - y| := by
          rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg h2]
          ring

name: abs_pos_relative_shift
doc:
**核心：平移 `k` 在频率对上是旋转**。设同一频率对 `(2m, 2m+1)` 的分母都是
`D`（`hD1`/`hD2`）⟹ 平移 `k` 后的编码由 `(PE(pos,2m), PE(pos,2m+1))` 经角度
`k/D` 的**旋转**给出：

  `PE(pos+k, 2m)   = PE(pos,2m)·cos(k/D) + PE(pos,2m+1)·sin(k/D)`
  `PE(pos+k, 2m+1) = PE(pos,2m+1)·cos(k/D) − PE(pos,2m)·sin(k/D)`

证明即 `Real.sin_add`/`Real.cos_add`（`(pos+k)/D = pos/D + k/D`）。
**诚实边界**：这是「逐频旋转结构」，不是分数的平移等变性——绝对编码本身
不满足 `IsTranslationEquivariant`（`RealRelPosEncoding` 的接口），
相对位置信息只能经此三角恒等式**间接**进入点积。
stmt:
theorem abs_pos_relative_shift (d : ℕ) (pos k D : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (h1 : 2 * m < d) (h2 : 2 * m + 1 < d)
    (hD1 : absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m, h1⟩ = D) (hD2 : absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m + 1, h2⟩ = D) :
    (absPosEnc d (pos + k) ⟨2 * m, h1⟩
        = absPosEnc d pos ⟨2 * m, h1⟩ * Real.cos (k / D)
          + absPosEnc d pos ⟨2 * m + 1, h2⟩ * Real.sin (k / D)) ∧
    (absPosEnc d (pos + k) ⟨2 * m + 1, h2⟩
        = absPosEnc d pos ⟨2 * m + 1, h2⟩ * Real.cos (k / D)
          - absPosEnc d pos ⟨2 * m, h1⟩ * Real.sin (k / D))
proof:
by
  have hm1 := fin_two_mul_mod d m h1
  have hnot := fin_two_mul_add_one_not_mod d m h2
  have hpt : (pos + k) / D = pos / D + k / D := by ring
  constructor
  · unfold absPosEnc
    rw [if_pos hm1, if_pos hm1, if_neg hnot, hD1, hD2, hpt, Real.sin_add]
  · unfold absPosEnc
    rw [if_neg hnot, if_neg hnot, if_pos hm1, hD1, hD2, hpt, Real.cos_add]

stmt: lemma causalDenom_pos {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : 0 < causalDenom s i

    · simp [h]

    · simp [h]

        (f := fun k : Fin n => if k ≤ i then Real.exp (s k) else 0)
        (fun k hk => hnonneg k) (Finset.mem_univ i))
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos (s i)) hle

        = (∑ j, if j ≤ i then Real.exp (s j) else 0) / causalDenom s i := by

name: complex_rope_phase_shift
stmt:
theorem complex_rope_phase_shift (θ m n : ℝ) (q k : ℂ) :
    ⟪complexRotate θ m q, complexRotate θ n k⟫ =
      ⟪q, k⟫ * Complex.exp (((θ * (n - m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
proof:
by
  unfold complexRotate
  rw [RCLike.inner_apply]
  rw [map_mul (starRingEnd ℂ)]
  rw [complex_conj_exp_mul_I (θ * m)]
  calc
    (conj q * Complex.exp (((-(θ * m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
        (k * Complex.exp (((θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        = conj q * k * (Complex.exp (((-(θ * m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            Complex.exp (((θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by ring
    _ = conj q * k * Complex.exp (((-(θ * m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +
        ((θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    _ = conj q * k * Complex.exp (((θ * (n - m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      exact congrArg (fun r : ℂ => conj q * k * Complex.exp r) (by
        calc
          ((-(θ * m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I + ((θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
              = ((-(θ * m) + θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := complex_phase_sum (-(θ * m)) (θ * n)
          _ = ((θ * (n - m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
            exact congrArg (fun r : ℝ => (r : ℂ) * Complex.I) (by ring))

name: rope_score_translation_equivariant
stmt:
theorem rope_score_translation_equivariant (θ : ℝ) (q k : Point2R) :
    IsTranslationEquivariant
      (fun a b : ℝ => rdot (rotateR (a * θ) q) (rotateR (b * θ) k))
proof:
by
  intro a b t
  change rdot (rotateR ((a + t) * θ) q) (rotateR ((b + t) * θ) k) =
    rdot (rotateR (a * θ) q) (rotateR (b * θ) k)
  have h1 : rdot (rotateR ((a + t) * θ) q) (rotateR ((b + t) * θ) k)
      = rdot q (rotateR (((b + t) - (a + t)) * θ) k) :=
    rope_relative_preserves_dot (a + t) (b + t) θ q k
  have h2 : rdot (rotateR (a * θ) q) (rotateR (b * θ) k)
      = rdot q (rotateR ((b - a) * θ) k) :=
    rope_relative_preserves_dot a b θ q k
  rw [h1, h2]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  ring

name: abs_div_sub
stmt:
lemma abs_div_sub (a b c d : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d) :
    |a / c - b / d| ≤ |a - b| / c + |b| * |c - d| / (c * d)
proof:
by
                                        
  have hcalc : a / c - b / d = (a - b) / c + b * (d - c) / (c * d) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hc, ne_of_gt hd]
    ring
  have hpos : 0 < c * d := mul_pos hc hd
  calc
    |a / c - b / d| = |(a - b) / c + b * (d - c) / (c * d)| := by rw [hcalc]
    _ ≤ |(a - b) / c| + |b * (d - c) / (c * d)| := abs_add _ _
    _ = |a - b| / c + |b| * |c - d| / (c * d) := by
          rw [abs_div, abs_div, abs_mul]
          rw [abs_of_pos hc, abs_of_pos hpos]
                                                                     
          rw [abs_sub_comm d c]

name: split_immediately_confers_concept
doc:
⭐ **拆分性即概念性**（体系 4.1「拆分性即概念性」/ 4.2 秘密归类）。

「`o` 可被拆出（在向下目光下呈现为概念，其构成是 `B`）」**就是**
「`o` 与 `B` 中每一成分都已有关系 `R`」——**这一步是定义性的**，
即**拆分的瞬间**（而非拆分之后）就已完成归类。

⚠ **诚实标注**：本命题**平凡**（它就是 `extent` 的成员定义展开），
其价值**不在难度而在【陈述】**：体系说的「秘密归类」在 FCA 里**是定义性的**，
本条把这一点**显式化**。它**不声称**证明了体系边界 2 的「构成效力」。
stmt:
theorem split_immediately_confers_concept {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop)
    (B : Set A) (o : O) (h : o ∈ extent R B) : ∀ a ∈ B, R o a
proof: h
